text:
Type: tall frameless mirror with rounded corners
Use: full-length dressing mirror on a wall or a door; bedroom, hallway, bathroom
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: polished mirror glass with a smooth ground edge
Colors: silver reflection, cool grey
Shape: tall narrow rectangle with softly rounded corners, a flat bare edge, sleek and visually light
Feel: clean, bright, airy, sleek
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, chrome or white accents; minimalist, modern or Scandinavian bedrooms and hallways

product.name: DRMMARE
product.description: Getting dressed is much more fun for children when they have their own mirror inside or outside the wardrobe door.
